procedural_matters: ITA 23520 -Xio- was represented by Gabriele Benussi (tactician).
GBR 51X -Django WR- was represented by Vasco Vascotto (tactician).
Ian Moore (navigator of ITA 23520) provided photo and video evidence.
Guillermo Parada (startegist of GBR 51X) gave evidence as a witness.
facts: The conditions in race #2 (1st inshore race) were 8 knots of wind and small waves.
On the first downwind leg ITA 23520 -Xio- on port-tack and GBR 51X -Django WR- on starboard-tack were sailing overlapped towards mark 4p of the gate both flying gennakers.
Before reaching the zone ITA 23520 -Xio- bore away and her bow was pointing towards the inner edge of the zone of mark 4p.
GBR 51X -Django WR- was sailing one boat width above the starboard layline of mark 4p and faster than ITA 23520 - Xio-.
At some point before or after entering the zone ITA 23520 -Xio- broke the overlap between the boats by bearing away.
GBR 51X -Django WR- and ITA 23520 -Xio- rounded the mark with GBR 51X -Django WR- to windward of ITA 23520 -Xio- at a distance of one boat width between the boats.
There was no contact and no injury occured.
conclusions: Since there was reasonable doubt that ITA 23520 -Xio- broke the overlap before she reached the zone, it is presumed that she did not do so in accordance with RRS 18.2(e).
ITA 23520 -Xio- outside overlapped at the zone gave GBR 51X -Django WR- mark-room, as required by RRS 18.2(a) (1).
